name: BoosterContextMenu
description: Right-click a booster in a server's Server Boosts activity to open their user menu, just like in chat.
author: Pharaoh2k
features: Right-click boosters in the Server Boosts Recent Activity
Opens Discord's own user menu, the same as in chat
Profile, message, roles, moderation and Copy User ID in reach
Works on given, expiring and expired boosts
Automatic update checking with changelog display
